title: GrOIL: Graph-Grounded Domain Ontology Induction with Constrained LLM Mediation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22135v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constructing formal ontologies from domain documents requires simultaneously enforcing corpus grounding, vocabulary consistency, axiom-level expressivity, and end-to-end provenance, a combination no existing automatic system delivers. We present a seven-stage graph-grounded pipeline that converts domain documents into a complete, auditable Web Ontology Language (OWL) Terminological Box (TBox) without any unconstrained generation step. Documents are first encoded as Unified Discourse-Hypergraphs (UDH) capturing entity participation and discourse dependencies; subsequent stages transform this graph evidence into a class hierarchy, typed object and datatype properties, and restriction axioms, with Large Language Model (LLM) usage restricted to narrow, graph-grounded mediation tasks. translated_title: 基于图约束的大语言模型中介的图基领域本体归纳
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22135v1 公告类型：新 摘要：从领域文档构建正式本体需要同时确保语料库基础、词汇一致性、公理级别表达能力和端到端溯源，这是现有自动系统无法提供的组合。我们提出了一种七阶段基于图的流水线，将领域文档转换为完整、可审计的Web本体语言（OWL）术语盒（TBox），且无需任何无约束生成步骤。文档首先被编码为统一话语-超图（UDH），捕获实体参与和话语依赖关系；后续阶段将此图证据转换为类层次结构、类型化对象和数据属性以及限制公理，其中大语言模型（LLM）的使用仅限于狭窄的、基于图的调解任务。配套的断言盒（ABox）填充程序将命名个体基于所归纳的TBox进行定位，支持基于SPARQL的功能性评估。每个生成的内容均保留完整溯源。
tldr: 本文提出了一种七阶段图基流水线，通过限制大语言模型仅执行图约束调解任务，从领域文档自动构建完整、可审计的OWL本体，同时实现语料库基础、词汇一致性、公理表达力和端到端溯源。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a seven-stage graph-grounded pipeline that constructs complete, auditable OWL ontologies from domain documents by restricting LLM usage to graph-constrained mediation tasks, simultaneously achieving corpus grounding, vocabulary consistency, axiom-level expressivity, and end-to-end provenance.
